concept.title: Anridge: The Eagle Mesa
concept.logline: On overcast, epic Anridge, you set out to recover the echo keys and restore the Eagle Mesa.
concept.source_prompt: Red Canyon. canyon gorge western cowboy adventure Classic quest chain
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Trailhead Post and becomes the one who brings the Eagle Mesa back to life.

key_locations.name: Trailhead Post
key_locations.description: The start: a trading post at the canyon mouth.

key_locations.name: Prospector Camp
key_locations.description: Prospector Camp: a camp of Anridge, reached by the trail from Trailhead Post.

key_locations.name: Echo Cave
key_locations.description: Echo Cave: a cave of Anridge, reached by the trail from Trailhead Post.

key_locations.name: Cliff Dwellings
key_locations.description: Cliff Dwellings: a ruin on the way out from Trailhead Post.

key_locations.name: Eagle Mesa
key_locations.description: Eagle Mesa: the far end of the gauntlet run, where the story ends.

characters.name: Sheriff Rook
characters.description: Waits in Trailhead Post and knows why the Eagle Mesa fell silent.

characters.name: Odo the Ranger
characters.description: Follows you from Trailhead Post and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Rock Stalker
characters.description: A rock stalker that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Mesa Sentinel
characters.description: A mesa sentinel that walks the same beat over and over. Learn the loop and slip past.

characters.name: Juno the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Anridge for anything shiny.

characters.name: Dust Lizard
characters.description: A harmless dust lizard that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Speak with Sheriff Rook in Trailhead Post
hazards: Sheer drops off the trail edges
Rock Stalker hunting near its lair
Mesa Sentinel patrolling a fixed loop

actions.value: On overcast, epic Anridge, you set out to recover the echo keys and restore the Eagle Mesa.
Sheriff Rook: "Find what was lost around Prospector Camp, Echo Cave, Cliff Dwellings, then bring the Eagle Mesa back."
You found the Prospector Camp Gem.
You found the Echo Cave Gem.
You found the Cliff Dwellings Gem.
You found the Eagle Mesa Gem.
The Prospector Camp stirs back to life.
The Echo Cave stirs back to life.
The Cliff Dwellings stirs back to life.
Everything is ready. Head for the Eagle Mesa.
The Eagle Mesa blazes to life. Anridge: The Eagle Mesa is saved.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Rook
nodes.text: So you've come to Trailhead Post at last. I am Sheriff Rook. On overcast, epic Anridge, you set out to recover the echo keys and restore the Eagle Mesa.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Rook
nodes.text: Back again. Trailhead Post is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Rook
nodes.text: Go to Prospector Camp, then Echo Cave. Whatever still remembers Anridge: The Eagle Mesa is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Rook
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Trailhead Post, Anridge: The Eagle Mesa was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Adventurous, even then.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Rook
nodes.text: Prospector Camp: Prospector Camp: a camp of Anridge, reached by the trail from Trailhead Post.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Rook
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Anridge: The Eagle Mesa back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Rook
nodes.text: Echo Cave: Echo Cave: a cave of Anridge, reached by the trail from Trailhead Post.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Ranger
nodes.text: Odo the Ranger circles your feet, then looks toward Cliff Dwellings as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Ranger
nodes.text: Odo the Ranger sniffs the air. Something about Cliff Dwellings has it restless.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Ranger
nodes.text: It turns toward Cliff Dwellings. Cliff Dwellings: a ruin on the way out from Trailhead Post.

nodes.speaker: Rock Stalker
nodes.text: The rock stalker watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Juno the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Trailhead Post. Juno the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Juno the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Anridge: The Eagle Mesa that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Juno the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Eagle Mesa after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Dust Lizard
nodes.text: The dust lizard freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
